Unforgettable experience with Summit Experts

After emailing and what’s app messaging for months, changing our itinerary many times, they were so patient, and accomodating with our custom tour requests, their communication skills are perfect. A Journey to Remember
I just returned from an incredible month-long adventure in northern Pakistan with Summit Experts Adventure Tours. We trekked through some of the most breathtaking regions: Skardu, Hunza, Shimshal Village, and made our way to Shimshal Pass, ending with the exhilarating summit of Manglik Sar (6050m). From the very first moment, I knew I was in the hands of true professionals. The entire trip was perfectly organized, from the logistics to safety measures. But what truly made this experience stand out was the team. Every single person was warm, supportive, and treated me like family. Over the course of the trek, they all became a second family to me, and I genuinely feel like I’ve made lifelong friends. The beauty of the Karakoram combined with the knowledge, passion, and dedication of the Summit Experts team made this adventure unforgettable. I felt supported, safe, and inspired every single day. I don’t add pictures, because you MUST visit and see all the beauty of Pakistan with your own eyes. Nothing can compare to standing there in person, taking in the vastness and the majesty of the Karakoram range. Thanks to the expertise of Summit Experts, I felt safe and supported every step of the way. The team’s passion for the mountains and commitment to making sure each trekker has the best possible experience is what really sets them apart. This wasn’t just a trek—it was an unforgettable journey, and I already can’t wait to return. I’m already thinking about next year and planning to do even more trekking in Pakistan. There’s so much more to explore, and I wouldn’t want to do it with anyone else but Summit Experts. If you’re considering an adventure in Pakistan, I cannot recommend this company enough. Thank you, Summit Experts, for an experience I’ll never forget.

 Chongdee C 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Beyond the ordinary
It took me some time to find the right words to capture the incredible memories we created during our trip to northern Pakistan this April—blossom season at its absolute best! The breathtaking views, the warmth of the people, and the richness of the culture left a lasting impression on me, all made even more special by the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team. Their approach was not just professional but also incredibly humble and flexible, ensuring we had an unforgettable experience. Our group of five Thai friends explored Skardu, Hunza, Passu, and Gilgit at the peak of blossom season. Guided by the company’s CEO, Shah, whose extensive expertise in hiking and expeditions was evident, we found ourselves on a well-planned yet refreshingly adaptable journey. We appreciated how our tour leader went above and beyond, recommending exclusive experiences—from an insightful cultural visit to a local Pakistani home to a glacier trek using a unique route. Unlike standard itineraries, this allowed us to truly get up close and touch the glacier, all while ensuring our safety with expert guidance. One of the highlights was our trek to Fairy Meadows. With hours of hiking ahead, our guide was highly attentive, carefully assessing the natural conditions and our group’s well-being, which made us feel completely safe every step of the way. I already can't wait to return to Pakistan in summer, autumn, and beyond! 😊 A little tip for fellow travelers: If you plan to visit areas that require trekking and hiking, I highly recommend familiarizing yourself with the terrain beforehand. You can always check with the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team about the travel conditions—just to be prepared, not to opt out! The beauty of northern Pakistan is absolutely worth the effort.
